hooks.name: SlopSeal: block agent install commands
hooks.description: Before the agent runs a shell command, pipes the hook payload to the slopseal.hooks.on_install module. The module reads tool_input.command and exits 2 when the command installs packages (pip, npm, uv, poetry, conda, and other package managers, including through sudo, env, bash -c, and chained commands). The agent must verify the package with the slopseal MCP tool instead. Installs the user runs go through the SlopSeal PATH shim, which verifies each package.
